title: OMS Atlas OCT Spatial Mapping
author: Brett Johnson
materials: Affix OCT block to cryostat chuck.

steps.title: Verify OCT Block Identity
steps.instruction: Verify the identity of the OCT block to be cut against the written request for sectioning.

steps.title: Acclimate OCT Block
steps.instruction: Remove the OCT block from the -80 °C freezer and acclimate it to the cryostat (-20 °C) for a minimum of 03:00:00.

steps.title: Label Slides and Cryotubes
steps.instruction: Label all slides and cryotubes with a unique BEMS ID and Part# corresponding to the written request and OCT spatial map.

substeps.instruction: Part# 1: Superfrost Plus slide, 5µm, H&E, OHSU, HSR
Part# 2: Superfrost Plus slide, 5µm, Cyclic Immunofluorescence (Tumor Panel), HMS, Alyce Chen
Part# 3: Superfrost Plus slide, 5µm (Set Cryostat at 12µm), Cyclic Immunofluorescence (Tumor Panel), HMS, Alyce Chen
Part# 4: Cryotube, 7µm, Single Cell DNA Sequencing, MD Anderson, Nick Navin
Part# 5: PEN membrane slide, 12µm, Topographic Single Cell Sequencing, MD Anderson, Nick Navin
Part# 6: PEN membrane slide, 12µm (Set Cryostat at 40µm), Topographic Single Cell Sequencing, MD Anderson, Nick Navin
Part# 7: Cryotube, 40µm (2 sections), Single Cell DNA Sequencing, MD Anderson, Nick Navin
Part# 8: Remainder of OCT block, NA, Single Cell Indexing ATAC Sequencing, OHSU, Andrew Adey

steps.title: Prepare PEN Membrane Slides
steps.instruction: Expose PEN membrane slides to a UV source at a distance of approximately 15-20cm for 00:15:00.

steps.title: Orient and Face Block
steps.instruction: Orient and face the block to obtain an adequate amount of core, avoiding excessive facing to reduce tissue loss.

steps.title: Cut Initial 5 Micron Sections
steps.instruction: Set the cryostat to 5 micron sections and cut the first three sections (Part#1-3).

substeps.instruction: Affix sections onto appropriately labeled slides according to the OCT spatial map.
Ensure all sections are sequential, maintaining serial order, adjacency, and consistent orientation.

steps.title: Collect Intermediate Section
steps.instruction: Cut one section (Part#4) and place it in a cryotube.

substeps.instruction: Note: This is an intermediate section generated during cryostat thickness switching; actual thickness should be approximately 7µm.

steps.title: Cut 12 Micron Sections
steps.instruction: Cut two sections (Part#5, 6) and place them on the appropriate membrane slides.

steps.title: Cut 40 Micron Sections
steps.instruction: Cut 2 sections (Part#7) and place both sections in a single cryotube.

steps.title: Store Samples
steps.instruction: Place all slides, both cryotubes, and the remaining OCT block in the -80 °C freezer.

substeps.instruction: Do not fix any slides under this protocol.

steps.title: Perform H&E Staining
steps.instruction: Perform hematoxylin and eosin (H&E) staining on the slide labeled Part#1.

steps.title: Deliver Samples to BioLibrary
steps.instruction: Deliver the remaining samples to the BioLibrary for distribution.

substeps.instruction: Include unstained slides (Part#2, 3, 5, 6), cryotubes (Part#4, 7), and the remainder of the OCT block (Part#8).
Keep samples frozen at all times; store at -80 °C and transfer/ship on dry ice.
